title: Unmarked Blackhawks during NOTAM experiments

tellings.quote: I mean, when you have Blackhawk helicopters, unmarked Blackhawk helicopters showing up in the middle of the night,

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says that during experiments run under a NOTAM, a formal notice warning pilots to keep out of a stretch of airspace, unmarked Black Hawk military helicopters showed up in the middle of the night. If true, it would suggest that someone in government was quietly watching what happened at the ranch.
